description: Open a job card for a job your crew is taking on and return its JC-YYYY-NNNN number: the client, the site, what the job is, the currency and when it is scheduled. Free tier: 10 active cards; archiving a finished job frees its slot.

client.description: Who the job is for, e.g. Kowalski bathroom refit, or Acme Ltd

currency.description: ISO code the rates and prices are in

description.description: What the job is, e.g. Replace the consumer unit and certify

scheduled_date.description: The date the crew is due on site, YYYY-MM-DD. May be in the future; it is a plan, not a log

site.description: Where the job is, e.g. 14 Nowa Street, flat 3

name: job_card_create
title: Open a job card
